newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China motorbike engine maker plans A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China motorbike engine maker plans A share IPO.

text.p: Chinese motorcycle engine producer Linhai Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 40 million A shares and will use the proceeds to upgrade technology, a company spokesman said on Friday.

Linhai has not decided whether to list its stock in Shenzhen or Shanghai, the spokesman told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin, adding that the issue needed approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
Jiangsu Securities Co Ltd has been named as the lead underwriter for the offer, the timing and pricing of which are not yet set, the official said.

Linhai, based in the city of Taizhou in the eastern province of Jiangsu, has produced around one million engines a year in the past several years, selling them mainly to domestic motorbike manufacturers, he said.
